Test & repair shop — parts riding a loop conveyor

The same job shop as the movable-resource version, with the transport replaced by an accumulating loop belt.

What to watch for

Each part rides to whichever station its test plan calls for next, but the belt runs one way. A part that wants the station it just left rides 130 cells all the way round to reach it — the cost of a loop, made visible.

Underneath

This is a real run of a real model, not a recording. The page fetched the trace (358 KB gzipped) and drew it through the same renderer the desktop animation application uses. Download it and open it there to lay it out yourself.

Read the model's source — the simulation is not modified to be animated; capture is a flag on a run.
